messages:
maya: 06:55 UTC handoff in ~5. Quick check before I drop: who's officially primary/secondary for the 07:00 swap, any coverage gaps, and do we have PagerDuty/AWS/Grafana perms in place for the contractor joining? I'll be moving to secondary now. :wave:
oncall-bot: Rotation notice: scheduled rotation -> sam becomes primary at 07:00 UTC. If immediate swap needed, ack here.
sam: ack — I'll take primary at 07:00. I'll monitor the search-api page and join the bridge. @ashley can you confirm the contractor's Grafana access (they reported 403 earlier)?
ashley: I don't see the contractor in the org users or teams. What's the SSO email?
maya: contractor reported as ci-ops@ext in the ticket. They need viewer access to the oncall dashboards only. Not full editor.
devops: To add to Grafana quickly you can use SCIM or the admin API. Example SCIM-like curl (fill GRAF_TOKEN):
```
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $GRAF_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' https://grafana.internal/api/teams/1/members -d '{"loginOrEmail":"ci-ops@ext"}'
```
Then set role to Viewer in /org/users if they still see 403.
lee: PagerDuty check: escalation policy "prod-high" currently has primary=Sam, secondary=Maya. Policy id pd-HIGH-42. If you need to swap the PD assignment do it via PD web UI or pd CLI. Also check the oncall schedule for overlaps (we had a gap last week around 03:00 PST).
maya: I tried to `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/OnCallAdmin --role-session-name handoff` and got AccessDenied. Contractors should not have OnCallAdmin right?
devops: Correct — contractors shouldn't get OnCallAdmin. For handoff they only need read-only CloudWatch + metrics. Create or use OnCallReadOnly role instead. Steps: 1) update trust policy to allow their principal, 2) attach CloudWatchReadOnly + S3 list if needed. I'll open a PR now.
oncall-bot: Active page: search-api latency spike detected 3m ago. Incident routed to policy prod-high. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/P12345 (internal).
sam: joining the bridge in ~2. Maya, can you paste the runbook link and what mitigations are already applied?
maya: Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/search-api-latency. Actions so far: scaled replica set +1, warmed cache prefix `v2-query`, toggled fallback routing for read-heavy queries. I'm tailing logs: `kubectl -n search logs -l app=search-api -f --tail=200`. Watch error spikes on 5xx and high percentiles on p99.
ashley: I added ci-ops@ext to the oncall-viewers team and set org role Viewer. If they still get 403, let me know — sometimes SCIM sync delays ~2-3m. (reacted with :thumbsup:)
devops: PR for IAM adjust: https://git.internal/r/devops/iam/+/234 — will be merged after approvals. ETA ~20m. If you need a faster workaround, I can temporarily add them to OnCallReadOnly trust for this session only.
lee: Handoff checklist reminder: 1) confirm PD primary/secondary and escalation policy, 2) Grafana Viewer access verified, 3) AWS assume-role OnCallReadOnly confirmed, 4) runbook link + recent mitigation notes shared. If any step fails, escalate to infra-lead immediately.
maya: acknowledged. I'm handing off monitoring to @sam now. infra-lead contact is infra-lead@redwood.com or +1-555-OPS if escalation needed.
sam: taking primary. I'll post updates to this thread and the incident ticket.
oncall-bot: Handoff recorded: maya -> sam at 07:00 UTC. (automated)
